cŏmĭtātensis , e, adj. comitatus,
I.of or pertaining to the dignity or office of courtiers (v. comes, II. D. and E.; “postclass.): munus, Cod. Th. 12, 1, 38: legio,” ib. 12, 36, 14 : “fabrica, i. e. machinatio,” a court intrigue, Amm. 18, 4, 2 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
